gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: When a copied TagSet lazily pulls a tag through from the underlying source (e.g. the default HTML set), the source's {@code onNewTag} customizer must NOT be inv
ADDED i2: Register a customizer on the source so we can detect any unwanted mutation.
ADDED i3: Trigger a lazy pull-through on the copy: "div" is not yet in copy's own map, so it is cloned from the underlying default HTML TagSet and added to copy.
ADDED i4: The pull-through must have gone to the root default set, not through source, so source's customizer should never have fired.
